doc.title: Filler Setup and Nozzle Check
doc.file: WI-210 Filler Setup and Nozzle Check.pdf
doc.purpose: Set up a rotary filler so that every nozzle fills inside the weight limits.

roles.name: Operator
roles.does: Sets up and adjusts the filler.

roles.name: Line Lead
roles.does: Is told about any nozzle taken out of service.

references.as_written: MP-501 Filler Lubrication and Valve Seal Inspection

parameters.what: nozzle weight deviation that stops the filler
parameters.applies_to: any nozzle compared with the others
parameters.quote: Any nozzle more than 3 g from the others: stop, tell the Line Lead, and call the Maintenance Technician.
you may adjust the fill setpoint by up to 2 g up or down.

parameters.what: operator fill setpoint adjustment limit per shift
parameters.quote: If more than 2 g of adjustment is needed in one shift, stop adjusting and call the Maintenance Technician.

parameters.what: bottles to run on a dripping nozzle before re-check

rules.topic: who may change the fill setpoint
rules.statement: The Operator may adjust the fill setpoint by up to 2 g up or down and writes the change on FRM-PR-10.
rules.quote: you may adjust the fill setpoint by up to 2 g up or down.
